Morgan (People Ops): FYI we've published a consolidated handbook update that merges recent small edits into one 'policy bundle' (PTO carryover, parental leave clarifications for variable-hour roles, and a formalized flexible-work request flow). Publish date next Tuesday.

Priya (Legal): I finished the legal review. Replaced vague terms like "immediate family" with a short enumerated list and added a jurisdiction note for statutory leave in EU/UK.

Devon (Benefits): Noted the PTO carryover change for non-exempt staff. Also added phased-return guidance for parental leave. Will drop exact benefit wording in the tracker.

Ruth (Recruiting): Heads-up: I'll update offer templates for part-time hires and flagged the recruiting checklist to include stipend eligibility for conversions. PR by EOD.

Ish (Eng Manager): Quick question: managers need to attest they've discussed the changes with their teams?

Morgan (People Ops): Yes  new attestation flow: managers fill a 1-line attestation in the tracker OR sign a DocuSign short attestation if they prefer a record. Both options will mark the team as "manager-acknowledged". Trackers and links in the sheet.

ack-bot: DocuSign envelope created for manager attestations (envelope id: DS-7821).
__notes: Manager attestation option (tracker or DocuSign) introduced to make this thread different from other handbook update threads. Messages are chronological and prefixed by sender names.
